text:
maria: Quick heads-up — want to lock a 60m slot for a design review of the new API+SDK auth surface + Console UX flows. Draft doc + PR linked below, asking for architecture + UX + security eyes before we freeze the API.

kevin: +1. share a couple slot options? I'm Pacific but can shift if needed.

maria: Thanks — thinking next Tue/Wed. Two options: Tue 9:30–10:30 PT or Wed 16:00–17:00 PT. Which works? Also posted the pre-read: https://redwood.internal/designs/sdk-auth-api-v2

sara: Wed 16:00 PT works for me (easier for EU folks). Will need the console mocks included in the pre-read — can you drop the Figma link?

maria: Figma added here: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/sdk-auth-console — added a note in the doc to see "Console flows" section. Also attached the PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/pulls/428

jon: Wed slot is OK for me. Quick ask: can we add a short runtime compatibility note? e.g., target models, KV cache implications. I'll prep a 5-min runtime slide.

leah: Can we add QA and security reviewers to the invite? pinging @qa-team and @security for availability. I can own follow-up test checklist if we confirm requirements.

maria: Updated attendees: eng-runtime, eng-ml, ux, qa, security, devex. Draft agenda in the doc; copy here for quick scan:
```
- 5m quick goals and success metrics
- 10m API surface walkthrough (maria)
- 15m SDK auth changes + migration plan (kevin)
- 10m Console UX flows + mocks (sara)
- 10m Runtime/compat & quant/kv considerations (jon)
- 5m rollout strategy + canary/fallback (leah)
- 5m action items / owners
```

kevin: agenda looks good. Request: add a short "must-ship/non-blocking" matrix for each change so PMs can decide minimal rollback path.

maria: added a table in the doc under "rollout" for must-ship vs defer items.

devex-bot: Poll created: https://polls.redwood/team/abc123 — Wed 16:00 PT currently leading at 6/9. React with :thumbsup: if you can definitely make it.

sara: :thumbsup: will review console mocks tonight and add comments.

jon: I'll add the runtime perf microbench results to the doc by EOD. small note: need to confirm batching changes won't break latency SLOs.

leah: QA checklist draft — added to the doc. Key items:
- migration smoke test
- token expiry/regeneration tests
- telemetry for feature flagging
- rollback steps + playbook

maria: perfect — can QA own the smoke test? assigning to leah in doc.

kevin: I'll post a small code snippet in the PR that shows client API changes, please call out anything that breaks ergonomics.

maria: reminder: if you haven't read the doc please skim pre-read before the meeting. Mark any "must have" comments in the PR so we can triage during the review.

deploy-bot: Note: there is a platform maintenance window Wed 16:30–17:15 PT. If we pick Wed 16:00 PT we should avoid changes that need deploys during that window. See: https://status.redwood.internal/schedule

maria: Good catch — we can still hold the review at 16:00 if we avoid deployment-only action items during the maintenance window. I'll add a note in agenda.

kevin: In that case Wed 16:00 still ok for me, just flagging that any immediate canary shouldn't be scheduled for Wed evening.

sara: Agree. Wed 16:00 still best for cross-region folks.

jon: copied runtime owners. I'll add the perf notes and a short fallback plan for KV cache changes.

maria: Final checklist before meeting (added to doc & pasted below):
```
- read design doc (required)
- review PR diffs and comment (required)
- UX mocks reviewed in Figma (recommended)
- runtime perf notes added (jon)
- QA checklist drafted (leah)
- add owners for each action item
- calendar invite + meeting notes template (devex will add)
```

devex-bot: Calendar invite sent to attendees. Notes template: https://notes.redwood/templates/design-review.ics

leah: I'll be on for QA questions and can run through the smoke test plan post-review.

maria: Thanks everyone — locking Wed 16:00 PT. See you then; will drop final pre-read bump 2h before meeting. :wave:

kevin: Thanks — will leave inline comments tonight.

sara: thanks, will prep console demo flow.

jon: thanks all, adding my slides.

maria: (thread lock) — if anything changes ping me directly."
